title: Proposal to Update National Survey on Informal Care to Reflect Changing Care Patterns
what_it_is: Proposal to Update National Survey on Informal Care to Reflect Changing Care Patterns

sections.label: Caregiver research and support plan
sections.summary: The Government monitors caregiving trends through studies, consulted over 200 caregivers in 2018, and launched the Caregiver Support Action Plan in 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Following the national Survey on Informal Caregiving in 2012, the Government continues to monitor the evolving trends of caregiving through research studies, such as the Retirement and Health Study by the Central Provident Fund Board and partner agencies, the Quality of Life of Caregivers study by the National Council of Social Service, and findings from social service agencies and other institutions such as Duke-NUS' Centre for Ageing Research and Education.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: In 2018, the Ministry of Health (MOH) consulted over 200 caregivers, service providers, stakeholders and grassroots leaders on the needs of caregivers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Following this, MOH launched the Caregiver Support Action Plan in 2019 to address caregiving needs in the community.

sections.label: Census caregiving data and targeted insights
sections.summary: A Member suggests a caregiving portion in the census or regular survey, but the reply prefers targeted engagement over broad surveys.

sentences.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Or in the alternative, whether they can actually have a caregiving portion in the census so that we can have a very clear idea of how Singapore is ageing, the trends we are seeing, every time we conduct the census?

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: I am not sure the Member's suggestion of doing a regular survey itself would achieve the intended purpose because caregiving can be quite different, where there are different needs for different segments.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: I think it is more important to be targeted in terms of reaching out to those who have direct nexus with caregiving and curate some of those insights in a more focused and deep way where it makes it easier for us to implement some of these measures in a more meaningful way, rather than do a broad survey that gathers broad insights, which may not exactly be applied to each different care setting.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: But we will continue to engage different partners and stakeholders to gain the insights as suggested by the Member.
